Title: User-defined network policy in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now available

Body.Content:
A user-defined network policy feature in AKS enables secure network segmentation within Kubernetes. This feature also allows cluster operators to control which pods can communicate with each other and with resources outside the cluster. 

Network policy is generally available through the Azure native policy plug-in or through the community project Calico.

Learn more
